time-window L2 norm of rhohat_mem_mean for every tau
ratios of those norms to tauH0=10

classification_rule.pass: all locked numerical/action-source gates pass at all seven tau values -> GE02_NONLINEAR_ELASTIC_SOURCE_TAU_CROSSOVER_PASS

claim_boundary: PASS certifies a controlled finite-amplitude action-source tau map. It is nonlinear at the source/stress level, but it is not a self-consistent finite-eta nonlinear evolution, halo prediction, collapse trajectory, or observational result.
anti_tuning: Do not change tau grid, mode set, phases, quadrature orders, spatial resolutions, redshift window or gates after inspecting GE02 output.
